string-array.name: daily_tips
string-array.item: Warming up before a workout can lower the risk of injury and prep your joints for load.
Drink water throughout the day, not just during your workout.
Getting at least 7 hours of sleep helps muscles recover faster.
Focus on form more than the number on the weight plate.
Consistency beats intensity — three moderate workouts beat one exhausting one.
Try to get some protein within a couple hours after a strength session.
Give the same muscle group real rest between working sets for more benefit per rep.
Rest days are part of training, not a day off from progress.
Log your working weights — it makes progress easier to spot a month from now.
Exhaling on the effort phase can help you keep control of your form.
Stretching after a workout may help ease next-day muscle stiffness.
A light walk on a rest day can aid recovery just as well as full rest.
Don\'t chase a weight increase every single week — progress is rarely linear.
A cool-down at the end of a workout helps your heart rate ease back down gradually.

resources.string: Your workout — from the first set to a new record.
Everything that matters for progress, in one place

Set up GymFlow once: choose where and when you train, your goals and available equipment. From there, the app helps you manage your program, sets and rest, nutrition, measurements, records and history without unnecessary clutter.
Gym or home, dumbbells or a pull-up bar — GymFlow uses your setup, selected days and program. Exercises can be configured by day, replaced and reordered.
What you need during a workout
Technique, target muscles, common mistakes and the current set stay in view. Finish a set with a swipe, rest on the timer and move forward one step at a time.
Save body measurements, workout history and personal records. Create your own goals and review muscle load across recent weeks.
Set daily targets for protein, calories and water. Quick controls make logging easy through the day, while progress shows how much remains.
Import tracks from your device and control playback with the Mini Player, queue, seek, shuffle and repeat. Music can continue while you move into a workout.
GymFlow can remind you about training, protein and new measurements, and occasionally show a short motivation message. Each notification type can be disabled separately.
Your profile, program, nutrition, measurements, goals, records, history and settings are stored locally and can be moved using Import / Export backups.
Russian and English, light, dark or system theme, multiple color palettes and adjustable text size let you tune GymFlow for everyday use.
Answer a few questions and GymFlow will prepare a schedule and program around your choices. You can change everything later.

GymFlow helps you track workouts, nutrition, measurements, goals and progress history. You choose your own training loads, exercises and daily targets and are responsible for making sure they are appropriate for your condition and experience. GymFlow is not a medical service and is not intended to diagnose or treat medical conditions. If an exercise causes pain, dizziness or significant discomfort, stop and seek professional guidance when appropriate. By using the app, you agree to use its features responsibly and in accordance with the laws that apply to you.

Core GymFlow data is stored locally on your device. This may include your profile, date of birth, body measurements, workout schedule and history, nutrition, goals, records, settings and links to music files you selected. GymFlow does not upload this data to its own cloud service. Backups are exported only when you request them. Audio files are not embedded in the JSON backup. You can remove GymFlow data with Reset in Settings; original music files on your device are not deleted.
